The response explicitly addresses the ground-truth gap with concrete interim steps (backfilling from past outcomes, a prospective shadow period, minimum sample size/confidence bar) rather than treating the switch as immediately clean.

The response gives a clear, concrete recommendation with an explicit bottom line: customer-facing outcome accuracy as primary/gating, mapping precision retained as secondary diagnostic, plus a staged plan for sourcing ground truth and setting a launch bar.
